Two VALIDATE commands cannot report their intended state on the real tree. (1) Task 2's final line `node scripts/efficiency.mjs 2>&1 | grep -q "Usage:"` runs under the block's `set -euo pipefail`; AC-A6 requires the bare invocation to KEEP exiting non-zero (2) after the fix, but under pipefail that non-zero exit from `node` propagates as the pipeline's — and therefore the whole VALIDATE block's — final exit status even when `grep` finds the expected match, so this command reports FAILURE precisely when the implementation is correct: an always-fail defect, the mirror image of an always-pass one. Fix shape: `out=$(node scripts/efficiency.mjs 2>&1 || true); printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q "Usage:"`. (2) Task 4's `norm docs/decisions.md | grep -q "timestamp_degraded"` is vacuous: docs/decisions.md already contains the literal token `timestamp_degraded` several times in the pre-existing [2026-07-31] entry (confirmed in the current tree at commit 5302839, e.g. lines ~1354 and ~1373), so this assertion is satisfied identically before AND after Task 4(b) adds the new dated entry AC-A11 requires — it verifies nothing about whether the new entry actually landed. Fix shape: grep for a substring unique to the NEW entry instead, e.g. its dated heading or a phrase like "exclusion-over-classification".
